title: Protein lollipop plots
text: small table frozen, offline snapshot derived InterPro’s representative-domain matches UniProt P36888 (FLT3), retrieved 2026-08-13. Current annotations can instead requested explicitly mutglyph_interpro_domains("P36888"); plotting never requires network access. Dense hotspots often contain several different protein changes nearby residues. displaced layout reserves marker space pixels, labels recurrent changes, uses curved connectors preserve true protein position. logarithmic recurrence axis keeps moderately recurrent mutations visible beside dominant hotspots. Singletons omitted default; set minCount = 1 include . Set labelPos selected residues basic view. mutation-event distinct-sample counts remain available tooltips generated specification. mutation input can also regular data frame containing position optional mutation, variant_class, sample, count columns, custom pre-aggregated analyses use renderer.
code: flt3_domains <- data.frame(   start = c(246, 438, 564, 756),   end = c(357, 531, 695, 958),   label = c("Ig-like", "Ig-like", "Kinase N", "Kinase C"),   description = c(     "Immunoglobulin-like region",     "Immunoglobulin-like region",     "Protein kinase N-terminal region",     "Protein kinase C-terminal region"   ),   accession = c(     "G3DSA:2.60.40.10", "G3DSA:2.60.40.10",     "G3DSA:3.30.200.20", "G3DSA:1.10.510.10"   ),   source_database = "cathgene3d",   protein_id = "P36888",   protein_length = 993 ) mutglyph_lollipop_plot(   laml,   gene = "FLT3",   AACol = "Protein_Change",   domains = flt3_domains,   height = 420 ) mutglyph_lollipop_plot(   laml,   gene = "FLT3",   AACol = "Protein_Change",   domains = flt3_domains,   layout = "displaced",   count = "samples",   height = 500 )

text: Clinical tracks can categorical numeric. track gets independent scale, categorical tracks use GenomeSpy’s default categorical palette unless Vega scheme explicit mapping supplied. transition/ transversion track computed MAF variants. title: Customizing oncoplots
text: Custom bars use two-column data frame. first column identifies sample gene; numeric second column supplies value name becomes axis title. numeric clinical field name can used directly top bar. Custom top right data replace default stacked summaries. custom left bar adds new gene-aligned column. Missing displayed keys shown zero reported warning.
code: genes <- as.character(maftools::getGeneSummary(laml)$Hugo_Symbol[1:10])  variants <- maftools::subsetMaf(   laml,   genes = genes,   fields = c("Hugo_Symbol", "i_TumorVAF_WU"),   includeSyn = FALSE,   mafObj = FALSE )  mean_vaf <- aggregate(i_TumorVAF_WU ~ Hugo_Symbol, variants, mean) names(mean_vaf) <- c("gene", "Mean VAF (%)") mutglyph_oncoplot(   laml,   genes = genes,   keepGeneOrder = TRUE,   topBarData = "days_to_last_followup",   leftBarData = mean_vaf,   leftBarLims = c(0, 100),   titleText = "Follow-up and mean variant allele frequency" )

title: Interactive Cancer Genomics Plots
text: mutglyph_oncoplot() deliberately imitates maftools::oncoplot(). accepts MAF objects, preserves familiar argument names behavior practical, reproduces standard oncoplot composition. common calls, switching interactive GenomeSpy output often just function-name change: MutGlyph complete clone every maftools option. focused API covers common oncoplot workflow adding linked navigation, tooltips, clinical tracks, SVG export. Rainfall plots follow approach. Potential kataegis loci can detected annotated interactively: Protein lollipops two layouts. basic layout stays close maftools, displaced layout separates recurrent hotspots connects every displayed marker back true residue. Singletons omitted displaced layout default: function accepts regular mutation data frame, making custom pre-aggregated inputs composable either custom InterPro domains. bundled pik3ca_tcga_brca table provides compact real-data example.
code: # Static maftools plot maftools::oncoplot(maf = laml, top = 10)  # Interactive MutGlyph plot mutglyph_oncoplot(maf = laml, top = 10) brca <- maftools::read.maf(   maf = system.file("extdata", "brca.maf.gz", package = "maftools"),   verbose = FALSE )  mutglyph_rainfall_plot(   maf = brca,   detectChangePoints = TRUE ) # Frozen InterPro representative-domain matches for FLT3 (UniProt P36888). # Fetch current annotations with mutglyph_interpro_domains("P36888"). flt3_domains <- data.frame(   start = c(246, 438, 564, 756),   end = c(357, 531, 695, 958),   label = c("Ig-like", "Ig-like", "Kinase N", "Kinase C"),   protein_length = 993 )  mutglyph_lollipop_plot(   laml,   gene = "FLT3",   AACol = "Protein_Change",   domains = flt3_domains )  mutglyph_lollipop_plot(   laml,   gene = "FLT3",   AACol = "Protein_Change",   domains = flt3_domains,   layout = "displaced" )

text: maf maftools MAF object data frame. data frame must contain numeric position mutation column selected AACol. Optional columns gene, mutation, variant_class (classification), sample, count. gene One gene symbol. Required MAF input; optional custom data frame contains exactly one value gene column. AACol Optional column containing protein changes. MAF input, HGVSp_Short, Protein_Change, AAChange tried order. labelPos Amino-acid positions label, "". displaced layout labels mutations default; basic layout labels none. showMutationRate Include mutated-sample fraction title. showDomainLabel Draw ranged labels inside protein domains. refSeqID, proteinID Optional RefSeq transcript protein identifier. colors Optional named character vector overriding mutation-class colors. domains Optional custom domain data frame start, end, label columns. description protein_length optional. proteinLength Optional protein length amino acids. layout Either "basic" true-position vertical lollipops "displaced" collision-aware markers, labels, connectors. count Use mutation "events" (maftools convention) distinct tumor "samples" recurrence heights. pre-aggregated data frame, also defines count column represents. minCount Minimum plotted recurrence selected count mode. NULL, basic layout uses one displaced layout uses two. yScale "linear" "log". NULL, basic plots use linear displaced plots use logarithmic scaling. showLegend Show mutation-class legend. pointSize Relative marker-size multiplier. width, height Widget dimensions. elementId Optional element ID.

Inter-event distances calculated independently within chromosome, chromosome boundaries create artificial distances. detectChangePoints = TRUE, detected kataegis intervals shaded marked upward arrows. complete locus table retained plot$x$spec$datasets$kataegis files written side effect.
